# valid-skill

## Overview
A minimal compliant fixture used by skillify's own tests. Trigger class: (a) verified-success-promotion.

## When to Use
- Used only as a fixture for `validate.sh` integration tests.

## When NOT to Use
- Anywhere outside skillify's test suite.

## Mandatory Procedure
- Exists.
- Passes the validator.

## Relationship to other skills
- Test-only fixture for skillify.
